parameters.content:
## Workflow E - add the archive (run once)
Adds the Zacks articles from 28 Jul to 11 Nov (older than Workflow A's grouping window) to lb_articles, one story each (phase = archive).
B finds them only when a listener's own words match (search step), and says when they were reported. No LLM, no cost.
Then run Workflow D (pre-extraction) with ?from=2026-07-01 to extract their facts.
